title: Periodicity and Period-Length Bounds for Browkin $p$-Adic Continued Fractions
summary: Continued fractions have been introduced and studied in the field of $p$--adic numbers by several authors, with the aim of developing analogues of the classical theory of real continued fractions. In this paper, we focus on Browkin's continued fraction algorithm, for which several fundamental questions remain open, especially concerning periodic expansions of quadratic irrationals. In this paper, we solve a conjecture about periodicity left open in [6].
